name: Breath
doc: Breath (the Hexadragon's enemy attack): the root and the director - two swirls and lit breath particles at the caster's mouth, then three clouds of breath rolling toward the target, each a burst, a lit puff with its particles, a rolling cloud model pair and a ring pair, with splatter sprites on the target; the sounds; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag157_breath.cpp) run on the program's memory (its particle table, frames and queues in the module, its packets in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The timeline: the two mouths (the caster's effect point and an offset, aimed at the target), when the swirls, the breath and the three clouds start, the sounds; the damage
